response: Chris Hipkins is a New Zealand politician who has served as the 41st Prime Minister of New Zealand since 2022. He is a member of the New Zealand Labour Party and has held various ministerial roles in the New Zealand government. Prior to becoming Prime Minister, Hipkins served as the Deputy Prime Minister and was responsible for several portfolios including Education, Police, and most notably, he led New Zealand's response to the COVID-19 pandemic as the Minister of COVID-19 Response. He became Acting Prime Minister in October 2021 following the resignation of Jacinda Ardern and was subsequently elected as the party's leader and thus became the Prime Minister of New Zealand.
